lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mo6Pb4Sn2O16 (reduced formula Mo3Pb2SnO8) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 30 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral MoO4 and SnO4 environments, each with four oxygen neighbors, while Pb adopts a close-packed-like 12-oxygen local arrangement. The Mo and Sn tetrahedra share corners, and the 12-vertex Pb polyhedra share faces with both Mo and Sn tetrahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 30 sites.
